selected_evidence.requirement: Initial node1 primary with node2/node3 replicas and infra:proof=ready
selected_evidence.summary: node1 reported two online replicas and the write was acknowledged twice; both replicas returned infra:proof=ready with replication links up.
Each Sentinel reported infra-primary, quorum 2, two replicas, and two peer Sentinels.

selected_evidence.requirement: Authenticated TLS on Redis 6379 and Sentinel 26379 over the cache network
selected_evidence.summary: Plaintext, missing-client-certificate, and missing-password tests failed; authenticated mutual-TLS requests returned PONG. Every node has a CA-verified IP certificate and TLS-only listeners configured on its cache IP.
The file is root-owned mode 600, contains Redis/Sentinel and TLS fields, and its credentials successfully authenticated to both services without exposing their values.

selected_evidence.requirement: Automatic promotion and recovered former primary as synchronized replica
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline preceded the outage. While node1 Redis was inactive and Sentinel quorum remained, logs captured objective-down, election, node2 promotion, node3 reconfiguration, and switch-master. Node2 served existing data and accepted a replicated write. After restoration, node1 transitioned to replica of node2, completed synchronization, and the final primary reported both replicas online.
